summary: Mutable mapping wrapper that reads and writes the Pleiades extended EQDSK dialect.

identity.relation: Deterministic text serialization/deserialization of Pleiades EQDSK records
identity.direction: extended EQDSK text and validated dictionary/class state
identity.definition: 48-character title, four integer fields, four 5-value scalar records, five profiles, C-order psi grid, q profile and fixed-width limiter/vessel coordinate pairs Optional supplied R/Z or r_origin/z_origin must match the dialect fixed origin; otherwise writing raises before destination truncation.
identity.model: Pleiades legacy extended dialect retained from D0 lexical successor
identity.geometry: nnr by nnz grid reconstructed as R linspace(0,rbox) and Z linspace(-zbox/2,zbox/2)
identity.coordinates: R/Z coordinate values in source-defined convention; units and COCOS unspecified
identity.boundary: Strict mode rejects trailing records; non-strict permits trailing records after complete declared sections
assumptions: Finite real values and fixed-width coordinate fields
This is not standard EFIT gEQDSK

inputs.name: fname
inputs.constraints: If supplied, parsed before state replacement

preconditions: No path creates an empty wrapper; supplied path must be the declared Pleiades extended dialect.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: EQDSKFormatError before destination truncation for writer validation or malformed reader records.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Filesystem errors propagate; parse errors are EQDSKFormatError.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Class wrapper preserves previous mapping when a read fails.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel implementation derived from retained Pleiades geometry, analysis, or IO behavior; the current relation and its limits are defined by source and regression tests. License basis: licenses/Pleiades-MIT.txt.
public_references: L. L. Lao, G EQDSK FORMAT, 7 February 1997, EFIT format specification.
provenance.license_status: MIT attribution and notice obligations are retained in licenses/Pleiades-MIT.txt; scientific and release approval remain pending.

example.description: Construct the empty mutable EQDSK mapping wrapper used for caller-supplied records.
example.code:
from scirel.io.eqdsk import EQDSK

state = EQDSK()
assert state == {}
state["title"] = "EXAMPLE"
assert state["title"] == "EXAMPLE"
example.expected: EQDSK() returns an empty mutable mapping; caller fields can then be assigned.

scope: Roundtrip, lexical fixed-width, malformed input and class-state tests
Nonzero-origin rejection, unchanged destination on failure, opaque scalar preservation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Structural IO qualification only; no physical interpretation or release approval.
known_limitations: This dialect cannot represent arbitrary radial or axial origins; attach solver axes to detect loss before writing.
